# EdTech Vibe Coding

> Free, MIT-licensed Claude Code Agent Skill that guides educators and edtech builders through creating a new education or training app with AI, using a 4-stage spec-first vibe coding workflow: Idea → Spec & UI Design → Build → Launch. It produces a PRD and TDD in the repository, a clickable React prototype, a per-feature build loop with acceptance checks and security review, and a hardened VPS deployment with tested backups, plus checks for student data privacy (FERPA, COPPA, GDPR), accessibility (WCAG 2.2 AA), role-based access and assessment integrity.

Author: Chuong Life (https://github.com/chuonglife). Adapted from the Vibe Code Roadmap v2 by class.mecode.pro.

## Install
- Claude Code: `/plugin marketplace add chuonglife/edtech-vibe-coding` then `/plugin install edtech-vibe-coding@edtech-vibe-coding`
- Manual: clone the repository, create `~/.claude/skills/` if it is missing, then copy the folder `skills/edtech-vibe-coding` to `~/.claude/skills/edtech-vibe-coding` (so that `~/.claude/skills/edtech-vibe-coding/SKILL.md` exists)
- Claude.ai (Idea and PRD stages only): turn on Code execution and file creation in Settings → Capabilities, then upload the release zip in Customize → Skills → "+" → Create skill → Upload a skill
- Needs: Claude Code (https://code.claude.com/docs/en/setup), Node.js LTS, git, a GitHub account; for launch a VPS and a domain

## Files
- [README](https://github.com/chuonglife/edtech-vibe-coding/blob/main/README.md): overview, install, FAQ
- [SKILL.md](https://github.com/chuonglife/edtech-vibe-coding/blob/main/skills/edtech-vibe-coding/SKILL.md): the workflow Claude follows
- [prompts.md](https://github.com/chuonglife/edtech-vibe-coding/blob/main/skills/edtech-vibe-coding/references/prompts.md): 35 numbered prompts, S1.1 to S4.13
- [prd-template.md](https://github.com/chuonglife/edtech-vibe-coding/blob/main/skills/edtech-vibe-coding/references/prd-template.md): PRD template for education apps
- [tdd-template.md](https://github.com/chuonglife/edtech-vibe-coding/blob/main/skills/edtech-vibe-coding/references/tdd-template.md): TDD template
- [edu-checklist.md](https://github.com/chuonglife/edtech-vibe-coding/blob/main/skills/edtech-vibe-coding/references/edu-checklist.md): privacy, accessibility, integrity, interoperability checklist
- [example-prd-quiz-app.md](https://github.com/chuonglife/edtech-vibe-coding/blob/main/skills/edtech-vibe-coding/references/example-prd-quiz-app.md): example PRD
